title: Mona Lisa
description: A half-length portrait painting by Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci. It depicts Lisa Gherardini and is universally recognized for her enigmatic smile and the masterful use of the sfumato technique.

title: The Birth of Venus
description: An iconic painting depicting the goddess Venus arriving at the shore after her birth, emerging from the sea fully-grown and standing on a giant scallop shell.

title: The Creation of Adam
description: A fresco painting forming part of the Sistine Chapel's ceiling, illustrating the Biblical creation narrative from the Book of Genesis in which God gives life to Adam, the first man.

title: Impression, Sunrise
description: The painting that gave its name to the Impressionist movement. It depicts the port of Le Havre, the artist's hometown, illuminated by a striking orange sun rising through a hazy, atmospheric dawn.

title: The Starry Night
description: A masterpiece of Post-Impressionism depicting the swirling night sky and the view from the east-facing window of the artist's asylum room at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence, just before sunrise, with the addition of an idealized village.

title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
description: An enigmatic portrait of a young girl wearing an exotic dress, an oriental turban, and a large pearl earring. The painting is renowned for its captivating use of light and the mysterious expression of the subject, often referred to as the 'Mona Lisa of the North.'

title: The Persistence of Memory
description: An iconic Surrealist painting featuring melting pocket watches draped across a barren, dreamlike landscape, symbolizing the relativity of space and time and exploring the depths of the unconscious mind.

title: The Kiss
description: An iconic Symbolist painting depicting a couple embracing in a field of flowers, enveloped in elaborate robes decorated with intricate geometric patterns and shimmering gold leaf.
mediums: Oil and Gold Leaf on Canvas

title: Souvenir from Havre
description: A pioneering Cubist still life painting, also known as 'Violon, verres, pipe et ancre', which deconstructs objects into geometric fragments and angular planes, exploring the depths of memory and artistic innovation.

title: The Scream
description: An iconic Expressionist masterpiece depicting an agonized figure holding its face in despair against a turbulent, blood-red skyline, widely interpreted as representing the universal anxiety of modern humanity.
mediums: Oil, Tempera, and Pastel on Cardboard

title: The Spirit Of Toronto
description:
A conceptual portrait blending realism with symbolic collage, The Spirit of Toronto reflects the emotional journey of migration and identity in a modern, multicultural city. The woman’s calm gaze is contrasted by a visual explosion of Toronto landmarks, autumn maple leaves, and bold typography — all emerging from within her mind like lived memories. Her traditional robe and composed expression suggest both pride and longing, while the surrounding icons speak to adaptation and self-definition in a new land.
The red mark across her cheek, while intended as a graphic element of strength and voice, also evokes a resemblance to Indigenous visual symbolism — particularly the red hand or red stripe used to honor Missing and Murdered Indigenous Women and Girls (MMIWG). While not directly referencing this cause, the artwork respectfully acknowledges that all stories of belonging in Canada unfold on land rich with Indigenous history, struggle, and strength.

title: Ballet of the Palette
description:
A dynamic Conceptual Fine Art piece that merges the grace of dance with the raw energy of artistic creation. Ballet of the Palette visualizes the “flow state” of the creative process. The composition features a central female figure in a flowing gown, reaching upward with a oversized paintbrush that acts as a conduit for a vibrant, swirling vortex of color, enveloping the subject in a world of her own making.
The subject’s expression of serene focus is rendered with the artist’s signature classical realism, contrasting sharply with the expressive, abstract strokes of the surrounding atmosphere. Vibrant hues of azure, burning orange, and white dance across the dark background, capturing a sense of movement and illumination. This piece explores themes of inspiration, the power of imagination, and the seamless boundary between the artist and their art.

title: The Rainy Arrival
description:
This piece marks the beginning of “The Artist’s Journey” collection, capturing the poignant moment of arrival in a new land. Set against the atmospheric backdrop of a misty Toronto day, the painting serves as a visual threshold between a past left behind and a future yet to be realized.
The composition centers on two figures sheltered beneath a vibrant crimson umbrella—a “portable sanctuary” that stands in warm contrast to the cool, rhythmic rain of Ontario. In the distance, the iconic silhouette of the CN Tower emerges through the fog, acting as a silent beacon of ambition and a landmark of a new beginning. Rather than a storm, the rain here symbolizes a “washing away of the old,” making room for the fresh perspectives and stories to come.
Medium & Style Executed in Oil on Canvas, this work showcases Mahshid’s transition into oil painting while maintaining her signature Conceptual Realist style—blending meticulous detail with an evocative, atmospheric narrative.

title: Timeless Notes
description:
“Timeless Notes” celebrates the power of women to anchor even the grandest public spaces through the resonance of their artistry. Set against the backdrop of Toronto‘s Union Station, this piece asserts that a woman’s focused voice is powerful enough to carve out a moment of stillness in a chaotic world.
Rendered in oil on canvas, this work utilizes the medium’s rich texture and layering capabilities to capture the interplay of light and motion. The composition balances classical realism with atmospheric depth, using soft edges and motion blur in the background figures to emphasize the transient nature of the crowd. In contrast, the cellist is painted with sharp, deliberate brushstrokes, grounding her presence amidst the golden, luminous architecture of the Great Hall. This technique visually translates the auditory experience of the performance, creating a permanent sanctuary of sound within the bustling urban landscape.

title: Fluid Realities
description:
“Fluid Realities” invites the viewer into a space where the boundaries of perception gracefully dissolve. True to Mahshid’s signature approach of merging realism, surrealism, and impressionism, this piece captures a transient state of being a visual representation of how our lived experiences and inner worlds constantly shift and flow into one another.
Crafted with meticulous attention to detail from the first sketch to the final touch, the artwork relies on dynamic movement and an evocative color palette to build an underlying sense of story. It is not merely an observation of form, but an exploration of the subjective mind. Designed to feel both timeless and deeply personal, “Fluid Realities” challenges the observer to find their own reflection within its evolving composition.
As a captivating focal point, this original piece is perfectly suited for contemporary collectors who value art that reveals new depths and narratives over time.
